tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Lightened from the pale lime behind the portrait.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, cards and inputs sitting on surface.

tokens.name: husk
tokens.usage: The portrait's background lime. Section bands, hover fills, the Progress track.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on surface, surface-raised and husk (14:1 or more in both themes). Also the manga outline on panels.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, dates, captions on surface, surface-raised and husk (6.9:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and the active nav item on surface, surface-raised and husk (5:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: The tunic green, the brand's loudest colour. Primary button fill, progress fill, highlights. Never text on light grounds; put on-accent text on it.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on leaf and straw (5:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: olive
tokens.usage: The portrait's disc, darkened in light for contrast. Large decorative blocks and the cover. Text on it in surface (5.1:1 light, 4.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: straw
tokens.usage: The hat. Secondary accent: academic entries in the timeline, book items. Text on it in ink (5:1).

tokens.name: straw-deep
tokens.usage: Straw as text: academic labels on surface and surface-raised (6.6:1 light, 9:1 dark).

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Skin tone. Small warm highlights such as the current-role marker and tag hover. Text on it in ink.

tokens.name: panel-shadow
tokens.usage: Hard offset shadow behind Panel and Button, the manga panel look. Olive in dark so it stays visible.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Panel and control outlines, 2px. 3:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Quiet dividers inside panels and between list rows.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid with a 2px surface gap, 14:1 on every surface.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The hero name, once per page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I build reliable systems and keep a log of what I learn.

styles.name: body-s
styles.sample: Descriptions inside panels and timeline entries.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section eyebrows, written as code comments.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon gaps, tag inner padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tag padding, gaps inside rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding on phones, page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding, grid gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Panels and buttons. Manga panels are square.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Tags and the progress track.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and the portrait disc only.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Panels at rest. Hard, no blur.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Panel and button hover, paired with a -2px translate.
